I need help with this

I've got you. Let's take the PSU first since that's the one in your hands.

Tell me what it's doing: nothing at all when you plug it in, fans spin then die, or the miner boots and drops out under load? And has that unit ever been overclocked?

With that I can tell you whether it's a PSU-only replacement, which we ship out without you returning the whole miner, or a full RMA.
Fan spins then reboots

Classic PSU sag: it holds for the fan, then drops the moment the hash boards pull current.

First thing to try, plug it straight into a wall outlet, not a strip or extension, and if you have another PSU of the same rating, swap it in. If it runs clean on the other PSU, it's the PSU and we send you one, no need to return the miner.

Has that unit ever been overclocked? That's the one thing that changes the answer.
No has not been overclocked

Good, then it's covered.

Fill in the RMA form and we'll get a replacement PSU out to you: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Put "PSU only, DC06, order Shop····, fans spin then reboot" in the description so it doesn't get routed as a whole-unit return. JD has it flagged on his side too, and he's quickest on Discord if you want to rule the PSU in or out first: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate.
